params.prompt:
Exactly EIGHT complete figures, FOUR columns by TWO rows.

Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and slender long torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: SPROTO #3215, the ONE GREEN/YELLOW superhero creature in reference image 1. Preserve its broad rounded head, long swept OLIVE/LIME GREEN spikes flaring far backward, YELLOW ear interiors, heavy BLUE oval upper eyelids, TWO sleepy solid YELLOW oval visible eye areas with NO BLACK PUPILS, green cheek/eye rim, very broad YELLOW muzzle/chin/neck and a wide curved RED closed smiling mouth. The reference eyes are sleepy yellow ovals under blue lids, never black cartoon pupils. No separate red clown nose. Keep the large cheerful round face and yellow lower jaw from the photo.
COSTUME MUST MATCH THE PHOTO: a broad opaque BLACK high shoulder mantle/yoke draped across the shoulders and upper chest, bright YELLOW fitted chest below it, RED long sleeves, and a RED double-lobed bow-like chest ornament with a small round green-and-silver medallion fixed at its center. This is heroic costume armor/fabric, NOT a business vest or casual jacket. Extend the cropped costume coherently as a fitted YELLOW superhero suit covering abdomen, hips and both legs, simple BLACK waist belt, RED gauntlets with connected fingers and RED knee-high hero boots. The black shoulder mantle flows into a knee-length BLACK superhero CAPE with a RED inner lining, attached behind both shoulders; black outer cape and red lining are readable in folds. All torso/hips/legs are fully clothed. No green bare body, no black ordinary trousers or sneakers, no white shoe soles, no letters/logos, no weapons, no extra jewelry. Same black/yellow/red hero outfit, cape and chest ornament in every pose. The thick RED smiling lips must form a very broad red crescent across the yellow lower face, roughly 65 percent of head width, just like the photo. NO TEETH or tiny thin red mouth. Reference image 2 is the APPROVED revised combat sheet; match its complete-body proportions, revised costume/face, exact colors and pixel style.

Exactly EIGHT separate full-body drawings in a regular 4-column by 2-row grid. A continuous guarded fighting footwork loop, NOT a run. Upper body stays calm, head/torso size constant, hips stay at the same height and same x center. Both fists remain raised. Feet are clearly different on adjacent frames: 0 near foot forward grounded/far foot back grounded; 1 transfer weight to near sole, far heel lifts; 2 far knee passes under low pelvis with far foot lifted; 3 far foot reaches forward while near sole still supports; 4 far foot forward grounded/near foot back grounded; 5 transfer weight to far sole, near heel lifts; 6 near knee passes under low pelvis with near foot lifted; 7 near foot reaches forward ready to plant. No feet crossing through one another, no sliding torso, no detached hips. Each frame has at least one clearly grounded foot. Last frame loops to first. Same complete body and clothing as the combat reference. Costume continuity is mandatory: BLACK shoulder mantle/cape, YELLOW fitted body AND legs, RED sleeves/gauntlets/boots, central red ornament/round brooch. Cape stays attached, falls with gravity, flares on dash/jump/kicks, stays behind limbs and entirely within each cell. Keep original wide green face, blue eyelids, solid yellow eyes WITHOUT pupils and yellow chin. Crisp pixel shading, no white highlights on black clothing, no floating effects. Exactly one complete body, two connected arms and two legs. Broad thick red lip crescent below the yellow muzzle, closed mouth without teeth. Do not shrink the red lips to a tiny line.
